## Description
Briefly summarize the changes introduced in this Pull Request and the problem/motivation they address.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality or turbine module)
- [ ] Performance optimization (improves latency, FLOPs, or VRAM usage)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style and guidelines of AcceleratorAI.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand physical/mathematical sections.
- [ ] I have added unit tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works (`pytest tests/`).
- [ ] All new and existing tests pass locally with my changes.
- [ ] Benchmark impact verified (if performance-related).
